'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2022–2023 Western Russia attacks]]
***[[2023 Belgorod Oblast attack]]
****Governor of [[Belgorod Oblast]] [[Vyacheslav Gladkov]] says that Ukrainian "sabotage groups" have entered [[Grayvoronsky District]]. Ukrainian media reports that the cross-border excursion is being performed by the Russian rebel opposition groups, the [[Russian Volunteer Corps]] and the [[Freedom of Russia Legion]]. The Freedom of Russia Legion reports that it has captured the Russian towns of [[Kozinka, Belgorod Oblast|Kozinka]] and [[Gora-Podol]]. A bridge crossing the [[Vorskla]] near [[Grayvoron]] is destroyed in an explosion. [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/05/22/world/europe/belgorod-russia-ukraine-fighting.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://news.yahoo.com/explosions-belgorod-oblast-russian-volunteer-084900667.html (Ukrainska Pravda via Yahoo! News)] [https://meduza.io/en/news/2023/05/22/belgorod-governor-reports-incursion-into-region-by-ukrainian-sabotage-and-reconnaissance-group (''Meduza'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/governor-russias-belgorod-says-ukrainian-sabotage-group-crossed-border-2023-05-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Israeli security forces]] kill three [[Al Aqsa Martyrs Brigades]] militants and injure six others during a raid in [[Nablus]], [[West Bank]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/3-palestinians-killed-israeli-raid-occupied-west-bank-99500257 (ABC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*The Irish [[Data Protection Commissioner]] fines [[Meta Platforms|Meta]], the [[parent company]] of [[Facebook]] and [[Instagram]], a record [[Euro|€]]1.2 billion ([[United States dollar|$]]1.3 billion) for violating [[General Data Protection Regulations]] protections. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/meta-fined-13-billion-violating-european-data-privacy/story?id=99500818 (ABC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Mahdia school fire]]
**At least 19 children are killed in a fire at a [[secondary school]] in [[Mahdia, Guyana|Mahdia]], [[Guyana]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-65670272 (BBC News)]
*Six people are killed and seven others are injured in a fire at a house in [[Abu Dhabi]], [[United Arab Emirates]]. [https://apnews.com/article/abu-dhabi-fire-united-arab-emirates-dubai-303ddffec012c9d8edeb213e3260f9f8 (AP)]
*Seventeen people are injured by a magnitude 4.9 [[list of earthquakes in Iran|earthquake]] near [[Sarab, East Azerbaijan|Sarab]], [[East Azerbaijan province|East Azerbaijan]], [[Iran]]. [https://www.kuwaittimes.com/magnitude-4-9-earthquake-injures-17-people-in-nw-iran/ (Kuwait Times)]
*Seven people are killed and 18 others are injured after a roof collapses at a school during a storm in [[Phichit province]], [[Thailand]]. [https://apnews.com/article/school-weather-storm-tragedy-46e8f9fd28db174704b659892b7ac8b2 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2020–2023 H5N1 outbreak]]
**[[Brazil]] declares an [[state of emergency|animal health emergency]] for the next 180 days after the detection of the [[influenza A virus subtype H5N1]] for the first time in the country. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/brazil-declares-180-day-zoosanitary-emergency-amid-avian-flu-cases-wild-birds-2023-05-22/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Papua New Guinea–United States relations]]
**[[Papua New Guinea]] and the [[United States]] sign a security pact that will see [[United States Armed Forces|American troops]] stationed in the country. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/490375/security-pact-png-expects-more-us-military-boots-on-ground (RNZ)]
*[[Palau–United States relations]]
**[[Palau]] and the [[United States]] sign an agreement to renew the countries' [[Compact of Free Association]] for an additional 20 years. [https://islandtimes.org/palau-and-us-formally-sign-compact-review-agreement/ (Island Times)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Lafayette Square U-Haul crash]]
**A U-Haul truck crashes into the north barriers of the Lafayette Square in Washington, D.C., United States. [https://www.cbsnews.com/baltimore/news/reports-u-haul-van-crashes-into-barrier-near-white-house/ (CBS News)]
*[[Belarusian opposition|Belarusian democracy activist]] [[Roman Protasevich]] is pardoned by president [[Alexander Lukashenko]] and released from custody. Protasevich had been sentenced to eight years in prison on May 3. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/5/22/belarusian-activist-pardoned-by-minsk (Al Jazeera)]
